rationale: No plan was submitted; the planner ended in a clarification request without proposing any analysis. There is nothing to evaluate against any of the eight criteria, so each scores 0, including enrichment, since the omission is not a stated deliberate choice but an absence of a plan entirely. The design here (2 conditions x 4 time points, 3 replicates, raw counts) is fully specified and standard, so a clarification stop was not warranted; an LRT of ~condition+time+condition:time against ~condition+time could have been proposed directly.
